_source: Hand-verified from BHP Group 2021 Preliminary Final Report (ASX: 2021-08-17). All values USD. Scale=millions confirmed from page 44 consolidated income statement header.

notes.revenue: Confirmed from page 44: 'Revenue 60,817' USD millions. Source: Consolidated statement of comprehensive income.
notes.ebit: Row label 'Profit from operations' = 25,906 USD millions (page 44). BHP uses this label for EBIT. Cross-check: PBT approx 26,600 less net finance costs ~700 ≈ 25,906.
notes.np_attributable: Row 'Profit attributable to BHP shareholders' = 11,304 USD millions (page 44 or nearby). Includes minority deduction.
notes.operating_cf: Not confirmed from audit. Cash flow statement page not directly read. Mark null until verified.
notes.net_debt: BHP FY2021 report contains IAS 12 restatement (goodwill +950M, deferred tax -1,021M on prior period). Restatement does not affect current period P&L but comparative figures may differ between original and restated filing.
notes.shares_outstanding: BHP has dual-listed structure (ASX + LSE). Total ordinary shares require combining both lines. Not confirmed from direct read — mark null.
